owner_directive: When a roaster publishes an Agtron reading, use numerical roast-development evidence to suggest the closest of the seven approved roast categories. Read the selected coffee product's complete relevant story/specifications to identify a corroborated estate/farm producer and detailed fermentation processing rather than reducing verified anaerobic natural treatment to Natural.

decisions.rule: Use the Agtron manufacturer ground-coffee Gourmet and Commercial named anchor correlations, choosing midpoint bands for our existing seven Title Case labels. Gourmet anchors (score:label) 95 Ultra Light, 85 Very Light, 75 Light, 65 Medium-Light, 55 Medium, 45 Medium-Dark, 35 Dark. Commercial anchors 71.7, 64.3, 56.9, 49.4, 42.0, 34.6, 27.1. A bare Agtron reading without scale or sample type may suggest a level using an EXPLICITLY DISCLOSED provisional Gourmet/ground assumption, never claim calibrated certainty; if sample is Whole Bean or reading is outside the usable roast-classification region, do not auto-classify. Explicit named roast labels and conflicts take precedence over provisional numeric guesses.
decisions.specific_result: PERC Kenya Mara Estate 78.4 Agtron maps provisionally to Light if Gourmet ground: Light anchor 75 is closer than Very Light anchor 85. PERC does not identify scale/sample on the linked product page. Preserve numeric 78.4 as the source fact and explanatory hint.
decisions.privacy_and_history: No automatic rewrite of an existing manually selected roast, Verified status, historical coffee/shot record, source evidence or release identity.

decisions.topic: Read corroborated producer and fermentation detail
decisions.rule: Read bounded, product-specific structured properties, metric blocks and narrative text together. When a selected coffee's title names an Estate/Farm and its own story corroborates that entity, offer it as producer. Never use roaster identity or a generic Farm suffix alone to silently establish producer. Distinguish base natural/washed drying from fermentation technique: explicit Anaerobic Natural with sealed anaerobic fermentation maps to canonical Anaerobic when existing process is Natural/absent, preserving exact original processing shorthand and fermentation duration as supplemental source detail. Do not invent processes from vague generic anaerobic terms, blends, FAQ articles, navigation or unrelated products.
decisions.specific_result: PERC Kenya Mara Estate: producer Mara Estate, canonical Anaerobic due explicit natural + anaerobic 96-hour sealed-tank narrative; original process text Adv Natural remains disclosed as supplemental information. Do not equate 'ADV Natural' alone with anaerobic without independent narrative evidence.

scoped_supersessions: Supersedes only historical extraction guidance that prohibited ANY Agtron roast suggestion. Unknown-scale scores now may provide a clearly labeled, reviewable provisional starting point while preserving all seven Locked roast-label meanings and coffee classification choices.
Does not add a new processing category, change the seven-tier taxonomy or authorize producer assertions on title alone. Original evidence and source audits remain intact.
